Expansion ideas > ---- Emerald Dream expansion ideas started floating around during the development of World of Warcraft: The Burning Crusade. A substantial portion of the World of Warcraft playerbase began wondering what the expansion thereafter would be. Although it later turned out to be about Northrend and the Lich King, there was also speculation that the main stage of the second expansion would be the Emerald Dream. This page means to list a variety of possible ideas of players. If you, too, would like to link your idea to this page, please put it at a subpage of your userpage ([[User:user_name/idea_name]]), then you can make a link to it on this page with the templa

The term emote means to express an emotion. In MMORPGs, emotes make your character express emotion. In World of Warcraft, you can make your character "emote" by using predefined slash commands. These commands generate a chat message (typically in a special color) that describes what your character is doing. This chat message is often accompanied by audio and some character action. For example, using the /thanks command, text displays ("Character thanks target."), an audio file is played (character voice: "Thank you."), and a character animation occurs (character gesticulates). Little is known of Emperor Ninjter. His coronation was celebrated by the tol'vir, and a long and prosperous rule was foretold. During his lifetime he commissioned plans for a massive Desert Palace, although there is no sign it was ever built. Tragically, however, Ninjter died very young and ultimately accomplished little during his reign. His organs were placed within a Canopic Jar after his death. Despite his short rule, Emperor Ninjter seems to have been beloved by his people. He had a pet cat named Chalyx.
